KPD Model with Linear Parameterization

Source: R/utils.R
kpd_mod2.Rd

Usage

kpd_mod2(
  edk50 = 10,
  kde = 0.1,
  kd = 0.5,
  ks = 3.5,
  gamma = 1,
  eta.edk50 = 0.1,
  eta.kde = 0.1,
  eta.kd = 0.1,
  eta.ks = 0.1,
  sigma_add = 0.01
)

Arguments

edk50

Dose producing 50

kdeElimination rate constant (1/h) from the virtual compartment KDE (default is 0.1).

kdElimination rate constant (1/h) from the response compartment (default is 0.5).

ksZero-order production rate constant (default is 3.5).

gammaHill coefficient (default is 1).

eta.edk50Inter-individual variability (IIV) on edk50 (default is 0.1).

eta.kdeIIV on kde (default is 0.1).

eta.kdIIV on kd (default is 0.1).

eta.ksIIV on ks (default is 0.1).

sigma_addAdditive residual error (default is 0.01).

An rxode2 model object representing the KPD model with linear parameterization. KPD Model with Linear Parameterization Omar I. Elashkar
